Josh buys a house for $80,000 and spends $50,000 on repairs, so the total cost is:

$$
80,000 + 50,000 = 130,000
$$

The repairs increased the value of the house by 150%. This means the value of the house after repairs is:

$$
80,000 + (150\% \times 80,000) = 80,000 + 120,000 = 200,000
$$

The profit is the value of the house after repairs minus the total cost:

$$
200,000 - 130,000 = 70,000
$$
